logs.title: Server logs

logs.tracking: No cookie and no tracking script is used.

cairn.title: Cairn
cairn.description: A personal wealth tracker, line by line. Each account (PEA, CTO, PER, life insurance, crypto) is valued automatically from several price sources.

dashboard.desktop: Cairn Portfolio screen on desktop: the overview of the wealth and its accounts
dashboard.mobile: Cairn Portfolio screen on mobile: the overview of the wealth and its accounts

allocation.desktop: Cairn Allocation screen on desktop: how the wealth is split between its investments
allocation.mobile: Cairn Allocation screen on mobile: how the wealth is split between its investments

holding.desktop: Cairn Holding detail screen on desktop: the information about one investment
holding.mobile: Cairn Holding detail screen on mobile: the information about one investment

starters.title: Starters
starters.description: A family of foundations (Angular, React, Spring Boot with a hexagonal architecture) and a generator that creates an application with tests, CI and conventions already in place. This site comes from it.

infra.title: Infra
infra.description: My self-hosted infrastructure, fully described as code: servers, DNS, shared proxy and monitoring. Cairn and this site run on it.

shortener.title: URL shortener
shortener.description: A short link service built for high traffic: unique identifiers without conflicts between instances, a cache for the most requested links and load balancing.

subtitles.title: Subtitle synchronizer
subtitles.description: A web tool to realign a subtitle file that is out of step with the video, with precise timing adjustment.

experiences.title: Experience
experiences.lede: In banking since 2018, from developer to tech lead.

points.1: Rebuilding the services of the new online bank: transfers, account and transaction views, direct debit mandates, cheque book orders.
points.2: Daily AI-assisted development and documentation of the front-end foundation.
points.3: One month in a task force on a production incident, then production support.

details.1: Angular front end with APIs generated by OpenAPI Generator and components documented in Storybook.
details.2: Spring Boot and Java back end, in hexagonal architecture, with Kafka as producer and consumer (Avro).
details.3: Storybook skills and MCP server to speed up AI-assisted development.
details.4: Two agile teams: transfers, then account views.

points.1: Leading 2 to 3 developers: skills growth, code reviews, technical roadmaps aligned with business priorities.
points.2: PIN code view, online card activation, bulk ordering of business cards, card design change.
points.3: Migrations from Backbone to React and from WildFly to Spring Boot.

details.1: Security: asymmetric and symmetric encryption of sensitive data (CipherTrust), GDPR compliance.
details.2: Performance: cache management and lazy loading.
details.3: Quality: SonarQube, JUnit and Mockito tests on the back end, Jest and React Testing Library on the front end.
details.4: Accessibility: W3C standards, audits with AXE, design system in Storybook with the UX/UI team.
details.5: Orchestrated deployments and monitored production with Kibana dashboards.

points.1: Bank card management journeys for individuals, professionals and companies: card blocking, payment limits, virtual cards, Apple Pay.
points.2: Agile team of 2 to 4 developers (Scrum, SAFe), with UX/UI, PO, BA and QA.

points.1: Web application for field survey officers: scoping, technical specifications, workshops.
points.2: Before that, a six-month internship in the United States (Xtreme Action Park, Fort Lauderdale) on an interactive kiosk project.
